title: Pure Pseudo Trap Monster
match: The Phantom Knights of Shade Brigandine
The Phantom Knights of Lost Vambrace
The Phantom Knights of Wrong Magnetring
summary: A 'Pseudo-Trap Monster' is a Trap Card that Special Summons itself to the Monster Zone with the clause '(this card is NOT treated as a Trap)'—led by The Phantom Knights of Shade Brigandine, The Phantom Knights of Lost Vambrace, The Phantom Knights of Wrong Magnetring, and the Paleozoic traps! Because Pseudo-Trap Monsters are NOT treated as Trap Cards on the field, they do not clog your Spell & Trap Zones and—most importantly—when overlaid as Xyz Material for Time Thief Redoer, they count as Actual Trap Cards attached as Xyz Material, unlocking Redoer's Quick Effect to place 1 face-up card your opponent controls on top of their Deck without targeting!

main: The Phantom Knights of Shade Brigandine
Premier Level 4 DARK Warrior Pseudo-Trap Monster: Special Summons itself in Defense Position as a Normal Monster (NOT treated as a Trap); can be activated the turn it was Set if no Traps in GY!
The Phantom Knights of Lost Vambrace

Level 2 DARK Warrior Pseudo-Trap Monster: reduces a monster's ATK by 600 and makes its Level 2, protects Phantom Knights from battle destruction, AND Special Summons itself as a Normal Monster (NOT treated as a Trap)!
The Phantom Knights of Wrong Magnetring
Level 2 DARK Warrior Pseudo-Trap Monster: negates an attack, Special Summons itself as an Effect Monster (NOT treated as a Trap), and sends itself + another card to GY to draw 2 cards!
Paleozoic Dinomischus

Level 2 WATER Aqua Pseudo-Trap Monster: banishes 1 face-up card on the field by discarding 1 card, and chains from GY to any Trap activation to Special Summon itself as a Normal Monster (NOT treated as a Trap) unaffected by monster effects!
Paleozoic Olenoides
Level 2 WATER Aqua Pseudo-Trap Monster: destroys 1 Spell/Trap on the field, and chains from GY to any Trap activation to Special Summon itself as a Normal Monster (NOT treated as a Trap).
Paleozoic Canadia
Level 2 WATER Aqua Pseudo-Trap Monster: flips an opponent's monster face-down, and chains from GY to any Trap activation to Special Summon itself as a Normal Monster (NOT treated as a Trap).
Paleozoic Marrella
Level 2 WATER Aqua Pseudo-Trap Monster: sends ANY Trap Card from Deck to GY, and revives from GY as a Pseudo-Trap Monster when a Trap is activated.
The Phantom Knights of Torn Scales
Core starter: discards 1 card to send Ancient Cloak or Silent Boots from your Deck to the GY (which immediately searches Shade Brigandine or Lost Vambrace!).
The Phantom Knights of Silent Boots
Special Summons itself while you control a Phantom Knights monster and banishes from GY to search Shade Brigandine, Lost Vambrace, Wrong Magnetring, or Fog Blade!
The Phantom Knights of Ancient Cloak
Banishes itself from your GY to search The Phantom Knights of Shade Brigandine, Silent Boots, or Torn Scales!
Phantom Knights' Fog Blade
Searched by Silent Boots: negates an opponent's Effect Monster and banishes itself from the GY to revive a Phantom Knights monster.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Torn Scales or Silent Boots.

Level 9 Dragon Fusion (2 Normal Monsters—since Shade Brigandine, Lost Vambrace, and Paleozoics are ALL treated as Normal Monsters on the field!) that is unaffected by monster effects.

Rank 2 Xyz that destroys 1 card on the field as a Quick Effect.
The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche

Cherubini, Ebon Angel of the Burning Abyss
